key_reasoning.reason: Multi-repo changes with distinct content across 2 repos — scope scored additively. Backend: CatalogPricer zero-rate guard (_has_usable_rate) in coding_agent_pricing. UI: cliAnalytics store (per-row unpriced_models derivation with a client-side mirror of normalize_model), cliAnalytics types, new SessionCostValue component, and its wiring into SessionsView, SessionBody, SessionTimeline and the shared MetricCard widget.
14 files changed in total (backend 4, UI 10; 601 insertions, 35 deletions); about half are tests. The production code change is small: 1 backend module, 6 UI source files, 1 new UI component.

The backend fix follows the existing catalog lookup pattern and is easy to roll back. The risk is in the UI: it re-implements the backend model-name normalization regex, which creates a cross-repo contract that can drift. The output is money display, so a mistake understates or hides cost. No security surface.
